description.value: Asteras is an authentic Greek taverna set inside a heritage home more than 100 years old in downtown Nanaimo's Old City Quarter, specializing in traditional Cretan recipes made entirely in-house from whole foods daily. The menu spans house-made mezethes, fresh seafood, slow-roasted lamb, and a dedicated vegetarian section, all served with generous portions and a full wine selection. The restaurant has earned six Best of City Awards in 2024, including Best Overall Restaurant.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and confirms Asteras is an active, sit-down Greek restaurant at 347 Wesley Street in Nanaimo's Old City Quarter, consistent with all OSM tags. Phone and address match between OSM and website; OSM uses the short name 'Asteras' while the website uses 'Asteras Greek Taverna' and 'Asteras Greek Restaurant' — a minor branding difference worth flagging. The menu page explicitly lists a dedicated vegetarian section, but no bike-specific amenities, washrooms, takeout, or wi-fi are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Asteras' but the website consistently uses 'Asteras Greek Taverna' and 'Asteras Greek Restaurant' — the short OSM name is retained per rules but may not match signage.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible sit-down restaurant confirmed by a live website with current hours, menu, and awards. A useful food stop for touring cyclists passing through downtown Nanaimo.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated vegetarian section on menu: Vegetarian Moussaka (eggplant, zucchini, tofu & béchamel), Spanakopita Meal, and Vegetable Brochette. Website also specifically calls out 'vegetarian dishes such as Moussaka and Spanakopita.'

wow_evidence: six Best of City Awards in 2024, including Best Overall Restaurant; heritage home more than 100 years old
